title: Score record
description: One file per channel at data/scores/<handle>.json. Three dimensions come from src/arithmetic.py, three from src/score_ai.py. Every dimension carries a reason so the ranking can be explained.

hard_stop.description: True disqualifies the channel outright. Disqualified is not the same as ranked lower: these leave the ranked list entirely.

warnings.description: Non-blocking policy signals for a human to check, e.g. a possible unsupported claim or an unconfirmed spoken disclosure. Never disqualifies a channel on its own.

score.description: null means this dimension was skipped, e.g. --no-model, not scored zero.

reason.description: One sentence. Shown in the UI when someone asks why a channel ranked where it did.

evidence.description: Video IDs, timestamps or citations the score was derived from
